summary: Nicola Mining Inc., a junior mining company, filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing initial assay results from two stockpiles at its Red Eye Project. The assays tested 47.82 kg of material, showing weighted average grades of 2.83 g/t Au and 753.41 g/t Ag. This is an operational update regarding exploration and processing potential under an existing profit share agreement. No corporate transaction, tender, or strategic change is involved. The filing is routine and does not constitute a special situation, as it merely reports assay results and planned laboratory simulations.
